notes.title: Downward Spear is live!
notes.content:
🎮 GAME RELEASE ANNOUNCEMENT 🎮

Downward Spear is finally here! 🌟
After months of hard work, dedication, and passion, we are thrilled to announce that Downward Spear is now LIVE on Steam! 🎉

Dive into a gritty, action-packed RPG where survival horror elements add a terrifying layer to your journey. In Downward Spear, you’ll face brutal combat, hostile environments, and nightmarish creatures lurking in the dark. Every decision you make could be the difference between life and death in a world where danger is always around the corner. 🕹️

🔗 Store Page: [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2311060/Downward_Spear/]Downward Spear on Steam[/url]
💬 Join the Community: [url=https://discord.gg/EGxJV79W5u]Downward Spear Discord[/url]

Key Features:

[list]
[*] Brutal Combat: Engage in fast-paced, visceral combat against monstrous foes, using a variety of weapons and tactical strategies.

[*] Survival Horror Elements: Fight for survival in a nightmarish world where resources are scarce, and fear is always present.

[*] Gritty Story: Unravel the dark mysteries behind the Downward Spear and face the terrifying forces that control your fate.

[*] Hostile Environments: Explore dangerous, eerie landscapes, from desolate forests to crumbling ruins, all while keeping an eye on your dwindling resources.
[/list]

We can’t wait for you to jump in and experience the world of Downward Spear. Please feel free to leave a review, share your gameplay experiences, and join our community of players! 💬

Thank you so much for your support throughout the development process. Let’s make this journey legendary! 🌍

See you in the game,
The imakegame software Team 👾
